_comment: Everything the bird can say in the player's voice, per game moment. The voice server speaks only these (by id, cue:index), so it can't be used to put arbitrary words in someone's mouth. src/voice.ts picks a few per player.
intro: Okay. Deep breath. I can do this.
strain: Nnngh. I think I need a doctor.
bigPoop: Oh wow, that was a big one!
accident: Oh no. Not in front of everyone!
That was not supposed to happen.
weddingRuined: You may now kiss the bride.
dive: Why is there so much water?
crash: This is the worst day of my life.
Tell my mom I was brave.
newBest: Did you see that? I'm the best!
